 Order

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.232/2023 registered at Police Amanganj,
District Panna (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376 (2)(n) of IPC and 5L/6 of POCSO Act.

Applicant is in detention since 06.07.2023.
2.
As per prosecution story, the applicant kidnapped the prosecutrix and committed rape with her.

On 02.07.2023 Viran, son of Jiwan Lal Kushwaha, has submitted written application to the S.H.O.,
Amanganj, District Panna that on 28.06.2023 he went to Panna and after returning back, his daughter was not found in the house then he searched out and told to his relatives.
On 01.07.2023 his daughter was seen on the roof of his brother in law (Sadhubhai) Ramkishor Kushwaha and on his calling, her daughter did not come.
Present applicant Rajendra Kushwaha came and told that prosecutrix has solemnized marriage with me.

On lodging report, Police registered the case against Rajendra Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169159274/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3 . Learned counsel for the applicant submits applicant has not committing any crime.
He has falsely been implicated in the case.
He further submits that prosecutrix is more than 18 years as per her Aadhar Card.
Thereafter, present applicant and prosecutrix has solemnized the marriage.
In the statements recorded u/S.161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., prosecutrix has not stated anything against the applicant.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State and victim have vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
They submitted that as per mark-sheet, the date of birth of prosecutrix is 10.10.2007.
They further submitted that Aadhar Card is not the authentic document to prove date of birth.
Mark-sheet is authentic document to prove exact date of birth and as per mark-sheet, prosecutrix is aged about 15 years and 9 months.
Parents of prosecutrix have stated that applicant took her daughter from their custody without their consent and he committed rape with the prosecutrix.

5. Looking to the nature of offence, age of proseuctirx which is about 15 years and 9 months at the time of incident, having taken into consideration the gravity of offence and other facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view it is not a fit case to release the applicant on bail.

6. Accordingly, present bail application stands dismissed.
(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE Sateesh Rajendra Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169159274/
